acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A self-reflection pipeline variant is triggered when a user requests project reflection (e.g., "Reflect on the current state of SpyHunter")
The agent queries all nodes with maturity less than 0.6 from Memgraph to identify areas needing work
The agent reads knowledge/system/pending-work.md and knowledge/system/debt-registry.md for existing tracked issues
The agent reads all flagged nodes (status = 'flagged') and their flag reasons from Memgraph
The agent synthesizes a structured report including: maturity heatmap by phase, flagged items requiring review, technical debt identified, missing test coverage, suggested next actions (prioritized)
The reflection output is compiled as a system type article in knowledge/system/ (e.g., knowledge/system/reflection-{date}.md)

package.name: neo4j-driver
package.purpose: Memgraph queries for low-maturity nodes and flagged nodes (via dedicated Cypher scripts or graph-search.mjs)

constraints.constraint: Self-reflection is a specialized variant of the conversation pipeline (Story 5.3), not a completely separate pipeline. It extends the same step structure with reflection-specific query steps and prompt.
Uses opus model for complex synthesis and multi-phase analysis of project health
Report must contain five sections: Maturity Heatmap by Phase, Flagged Items Requiring Review, Technical Debt Identified, Missing Test Coverage, Suggested Next Actions (prioritized)
Reflection articles are compiled at maturity 0.8 (high) because they are agent-synthesized analyses, not informal conversation insights
Reflection uses the same ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- and compilation path as Story 5.4 to persist the report as a wiki article
Pipeline must handle projects with no flagged nodes, no debt-registry.md, or no pending-work.md gracefully
Reflection variant is activated by keyword detection in user query: "reflect", "current state", "health check", "what needs work"

interface.description: Self-reflection pipeline variant extending the conversation pipeline
interface.steps: gather-context (shell) -> query-low-maturity (shell) -> read-system-docs (shell) -> query-flagged (shell) -> reflect (agent) -> compile-reflection (conditional) -> sync (shell)

interface.query: MATCH (n:Node) WHERE n.projectId = $projectId AND n.status IN ['active', 'flagged'] AND n.maturity < 0.6 RETURN n.nodeId, n.type, n.phase, n.title, n.maturity, n.status ORDER BY CASE n.phase WHEN 'discovery' THEN 1 ... END ASC, n.maturity ASC
MATCH (n:Node) WHERE n.projectId = $projectId AND n.status = 'flagged' RETURN n.nodeId, n.type, n.phase, n.title, n.maturity, n.missingSignals ORDER BY n.phase, n.maturity ASC

interface.frontmatter: type: reflection, phase: system, status: active, maturity: 0.8, tags: [reflection, health-check, sprint-planning]
interface.sections: Maturity Heatmap, Flagged Items, Technical Debt, Test Coverage Gaps, Suggested Next Actions

interface.description: Extends Story 5.3 conversation pipeline; uses Story 5.4 compilation path for persistence; uses graph-search.mjs (Story 5.1) or dedicated Cypher scripts
